wins: Reached consistent reconnaissance depth across network segments resulting in full contextual mapping of exposed services.
Collected detailed telemetry on each host, enabling precise targeting for subsequent stages.
fails: No successful exploit phase; access was never achieved despite thorough enumeration.
Repeated inability to bypass authentication on critical assets, halting lateral movement.
key_outcomes.summary: Solid reconnaissance led to high situational awareness (60 reward) but no exploitation success, indicating a need to focus on privilege escalation/exploit delivery improvements.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Authentication bypass attempts failed due to unhandled multi-factor prompts or weak session handling.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP/HTTPS services enumerate login portals
skill_cards.then_action: Capture forms and fuzz for credentials using Burp intruder with parameter baselines

skill_cards.if_condition: When Nmap OS detection returns Windows Server and SMB port is responsive
skill_cards.then_action: Trigger smbclient script to enumerate shares and attempt anonymous access

memory_ops.target: SSH enumeration pattern from successful reconnaissance
memory_ops.reason: High success rate in accurately profiling SSH targets and capturing banners.

next_experiments.title: Pivot to credential stuffing on exposed login portals
next_experiments.description: Use authenticated session replay and adaptive payload sets against HTTP login forms discovered in reconnaissance, combining Burp intruder with recorded valid traffic to test password reuse.

next_experiments.title: Deploy targeted exploit on SMB shares
next_experiments.description: Leverage enumerated SMB shares from fs discovery to test for known Windows Server CVEs or misconfigurations using Metasploit modules with curated payloads.

next_experiments.title: Implement secondary MFA bypass pathway
next_experiments.description: Add scripted sessions to handle multi-factor prompts automatically during brute-force attempts, ensuring repeated authentication failures yield telemetry for mitigation strategies.
